findings.title: Potential use-after-free in test cleanup
findings.disposition: Non-actionable: wz_machine_destroy releases and nulls owned allocations without freeing the static machine object; repeated cleanup and reinitialization are safe.

findings.title: Fixture path validation
findings.disposition: Non-actionable: Python str.startswith accepts a tuple of prefixes; all allowed roots end in a slash, and absolute paths, parent components, and unsupported characters are rejected.

findings.title: Pending I/O without CPU continuation
findings.disposition: Non-actionable: CPU I/O installs its continuation before the bus call. A direct bus API caller receives PENDING before the device cycle commits and remains responsible for retrying its request.

findings.title: Runner progress while pending
findings.disposition: Non-actionable: the runner loop starts only below its target; a pending cycle advances to that target, and the elapsed-tick guard rejects zero-progress cases.

findings.title: Version 8 deserialization
findings.disposition: Non-actionable: extension version 8 remains supported with a zeroed pending continuation; the new ten-byte field is read only for version 9.

findings.title: Clearing pending I/O with memset
findings.disposition: Non-actionable: the pending-I/O record contains only scalar fields and zero maps to its NONE/inactive state.

findings.title: Clock setup in the raster contract
findings.disposition: Addressed: the fixture uses the internal master-tick advancement helper, which also synchronizes ZX Net time when tracing is enabled; follow-up review found no issue.

findings.title: Incorrect logic for calculating largest slowdown
findings.disposition: False positive: deltas are stored as percentage points; negating a negative delta reports the slowdown as a positive percentage. The 40% gate is checked against the unrounded ratio before this summary calculation.

githubCleanupPolicy: Download the temporary proof artifact, then delete the workflow run; this workflow does not create caches.
